from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,re,statistics
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'.work/workload-native-20261116';sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
base=r/'zig-out/bin/sigma.exe';candidate=o/'bin/sigma.exe'
assert sha(base)=='379d6c6c069b9c3072da22fa6cea8b7deff77c5ed78ef9bbd070f92a724337bf'
protocol={'purpose':'Exploratory attribution, not adoption/performance improvement comparison','platform':'Windows only, QPC elapsed wall ticks; CPUTIME total user+kernel microseconds','samples':5,'warmup_exclusion':False,'affinity':'not fixed','io_scope':['fileOpen','fileClose','fileReadLine','filePosition'],'limitations':['CRT callbacks are not physical disk latency','summed callback wall includes clock overhead, excluding outer accounting','remaining wall includes interpretation/compilation, embedded graphics, VM, parser and measurement overhead; not pure compiler time','short samples, no AA calibration or >=5 sec requirement, not comparable to adoption gate','OS file cache not cleared; no GUI/audio/mouse/FRAME waits']}
report={'protocol':protocol,'binaries':{'baseline':sha(base),'instrumented':sha(candidate)},'cases':[]}
(o/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,indent=2))
for case in json.loads((r/'.work/workload-phases-20261116/results.json').read_text())['cases']:
 name=case['name'];args=case['runs'][1]['command'][1:];args.remove('--profile');idx=args.index('--measure-profile-reset');args[idx]='--measure-reset'
 assert args[-1].endswith(' BYE');args[-1]=args[-1][:-4]
 args += ['--measure-report','-e','BYE']
 baseline_args=[x for x in args if x not in ['--measure-reset','--measure-report']]
 p=subprocess.run([str(base),*baseline_args],capture_output=True,timeout=240);assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr
 assert p.stdout.decode()==case['runs'][0]['stdout']
 rows=[]
 for i in range(5):
  cmd=[str(candidate),*args];p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=240)
  (o/f'{name}-{i}.stdout').write_bytes(p.stdout);(o/f'{name}-{i}.stderr').write_bytes(p.stderr)
  assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.decode()==case['runs'][0]['stdout'],(name,i,p.stdout,p.stderr)
  m=re.fullmatch(rb'MEASURE ([0-9 ]+)\r?\n',p.stderr);assert m,(name,p.stderr)
  ns=list(map(int,m.group(1).split()));assert len(ns)==12
  hz,elapsed,cpu,bytecount,*rest=ns;calls=rest[:4];ticks=rest[4:]
  assert 0<=sum(ticks)<=elapsed
  rows.append({'command':cmd,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'exit':p.returncode,'frequency':hz,'elapsed_ticks':elapsed,'cpu_us':cpu,'line_payload_bytes':bytecount,'callback_calls':calls,'callback_ticks':ticks,'elapsed_ms':elapsed/hz*1000,'callback_ms':sum(ticks)/hz*1000,'residual_ms':(elapsed-sum(ticks))/hz*1000})
 assert all(x['callback_calls']==rows[0]['callback_calls'] and x['line_payload_bytes']==rows[0]['line_payload_bytes'] for x in rows)
 summary={k:statistics.median(x[k] for x in rows) for k in ['elapsed_ms','cpu_us','callback_ms','residual_ms']}
 report['cases'].append({'name':name,'source_sha256':case['source_sha256'],'samples':rows,'median':summary})
 (o/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(name,summary,rows[0]['callback_calls'],flush=True)
report['script']=Path(__file__).read_text();report['preparation_script']=(o/'prepare.py').read_text();report['patch']=(o/'instrumentation.patch').read_text();report['build']=json.loads((o/'build.json').read_text());report['checks']='12 baseline output checks plus 60 instrumented exit/stdout checks; deterministic callback counts; ticks contained in elapsed'
(o/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,re,hashlib
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'.work/workload-native-20261116';exe=o/'bin/sigma.exe'
control=o/'control.fs';control.write_bytes(b': MEASURE-CONTROL 42 ;\r\n\r\nMEASURE-CONTROL DROP\r\n')
rows=[]
for name,args in [('empty',[]),('file',[str(control)])]:
 cmd=[str(exe),'--measure-reset',*args,'--measure-report','-e','DEPTH . BYE']
 p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=30);assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.split()==[b'0']
 nums=list(map(int,re.fullmatch(rb'MEASURE ([0-9 ]+)\r?\n',p.stderr).group(1).split()))
 expected=[0,0,0,0] if name=='empty' else [1,1,4,4]
 assert nums[4:8]==expected,(name,nums)
 assert nums[3]==(0 if name=='empty' else sum(map(len,control.read_bytes().splitlines())))
 rows.append({'name':name,'command':cmd,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(),'exit':p.returncode})
results=json.loads((o/'results.json').read_text())
for case in results['cases']:
 if case['name'].endswith('-load'):
  file=r/('examples/'+case['name'][:-5]+'.fs');lines=file.read_bytes().splitlines()
  for sample in case['samples']:
   assert sample['callback_calls']==[1,1,len(lines)+1,len(lines)+1]
   assert sample['line_payload_bytes']==sum(map(len,lines))
checks={'controls':rows,'control_source':control.read_text(),'source_line_payload_checks':'all 15 load samples match source physical line count + EOF and payload byte lengths','script':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(o/'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(checks,indent=2)+'\n');print('Empty/file controls and all source line/payload counts passed')

actual_initialization.script:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,re,statistics
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'.work/workload-native-20261116';rows=[]
for game in ['pinball','waterworks','klondike']:
 before=['-e','0 CONSTANT NO-AUTORUN 0 CONSTANT NO-SOUND',str(r/f'examples/{game}.fs')]
 if game=='pinball':before+=['-e','BUILD-WALLS']
 check={'pinball':'DONE @ . GMODE @ M-TITLE = . DEPTH .','waterworks':'DONE @ . GMODE @ M-TITLE = . DEPTH .','klondike':'DONE @ . D-SRC @ . HOVER @ . DEPTH .'}[game]
 expected=[b'0',b'-1',b'0'] if game!='klondike' else [b'0',b'-1',b'-1',b'0']
 runs=[]
 for i in range(6):
  cmd=[str(r/'zig-out/bin/sigma.exe' if i==0 else o/'bin/sigma.exe'),*before,*([] if i==0 else ['--measure-reset']),'-e','INIT-GAME',*([] if i==0 else ['--measure-report']),'-e',check+' BYE']
  p=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,timeout=30);assert p.returncode==0,(game,i,p.stderr)
  assert p.stdout.splitlines()[-1].split()==expected,(game,i,p.stdout)
  row={'command':cmd,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(),'exit':p.returncode}
  if i:
   n=list(map(int,re.fullmatch(rb'MEASURE ([0-9 ]+)\r?\n',p.stderr).group(1).split()))
   assert n[3:]==[0]*9
   row.update(elapsed_ms=n[1]/n[0]*1000,cpu_us=n[2])
  else:assert not p.stderr
  runs.append(row)
 rows.append({'game':game,'runs':runs,'median_elapsed_ms':statistics.median(x['elapsed_ms'] for x in runs[1:]),'note':'NOW and random deal vary; initial-state invariants only, not full state parity'})
 print(game,rows[-1]['median_elapsed_ms'])
(o/'initialization.json').write_text(json.dumps({'cases':rows,'script':Path(__file__).read_text(),'scope':'Actual INIT-GAME with audio disabled and no display/input loop; pinball walls built before timing; not total startup'},indent=2)+'\n')
